gizmo.title: Rondedzero yekutarisa ine mabhureti
gizmo.description: Rondedzero yemabhokisi ekumaka. Vaverengi vanomaka zvinhu uye fambiro yavo inorangarirwa pamudziyo wavo.

configure.title: Musoro
configure.description: Zita rerondedzero. Rinoverengwa zvinonzwika sezita reboka remabhokisi ekumaka.

configure.title: Zvinhu
configure.description: Chinhu chimwe nechimwe ibhokisi rekumaka. Zvinhu zvakamakwa kana zvakadzimwa hazvigone kuchinjwa nevaverengi.

configure.title: Zvine nhamba
configure.description: Ratidza rondedzero ine nhamba panzvimbo peine mabhureti.

developer.title: ID yekuchengetedza
developer.description: ID yakasiyana inoshandiswa kurangarira fambiro yemuverengi pamudziyo wavo. Inogadzirwa yega; ichinje chete kugovana fambiro pakati perondedzero kana kutanga patsva.
